text:
Avery: Quick heads-up 11/23 promo credit from EuroVendor was applied then reversed. Vendor invoice arrived after reversal but it's billed in EUR while our billed credits were USD. Need treatment for month-end: accrue, defer, or use FX reserve? Total invoice EUR 28,000 (approx USD 30,160 at booking).

Nate: Are the customer invoices that were impacted in USD? Did billing apply USD amounts or local currency?

Avery: All customer invoices were in USD and we've already recognized revenue for 7 invoices. Billing applied credits in USD, reversal happened 2024-11-17, vendor invoice dated 2024-11-20 in EUR. FX rate at invoice date = 1 EUR = 1.08 USD; booking close FX rate = 1.075. Small FX diff ~ $250.

Priyanka: Short answer: treat undisputed reimbursable amount as vendor accrual (in USD) and mirror revenue deferral. Record FX adjustment separately per FX policy. For usage/overage credits reverse revenue immediately. For prepaid credits create deferral and amortize. Because vendor invoice is in EUR, book accrual at close using our USD functional currency using the close rate (1.075). When payment arrives, record realized FX on the cash/payment posting.

Avery: Here's proposed JE (USD amounts at close rate):
```
Dr Revenue Deferral (GL2100) 30,160
  Cr Vendor Accrual (GL2200) 30,160

Immediate reversal for usage portion (USD 6,400):
Dr Revenue (GL4000) 6,400
  Cr Revenue Deferral (GL2100) 6,400
```
FX note: invoice EUR28,000 * 1.075 = USD30,100; small rounding difference to USD30,160 reflects per-invoice mapping. Record a separate FX reserve entry if realized FX difference > $500.

Nate: Confirm vendor PO EV-2044 and payment ETA 2024-12-09. Also we need FP&A notification since >$20k. Should we separate the disputed small line item?

Priyanka: No dispute here; vendor confirmed full amount reimbursable. I'll prepare amort schedules for prepaid accounts (5 prepaid accounts, 2 usage). Use remaining term months for allocation. Tag JE memo "EuroVendor promo reversal - FX booked at close rate". Route to finance-leads@redwood.com and cc accounting@redwood.com.

accounting-bot: Reminder 11/30 month close lock at 23:59 PST. Post adjustments by 11/29 EOD for review. Attach vendor invoice and per-invoice mapping.

Avery: I'll upload the vendor invoice and exchange rate evidence to Confluence and ping when done. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
